name: Alice Third Macy
original_name: アリス·サード·メイシー
source: An exchange student from Britain who is also the student council president. Her home in Britain is actually a theater. She thinks that boredom is humanity's biggest enemy and actually won the elections with her saying, "I'll completely remove boredom from this school!". Currently lives in [url=/c22756]Momoka's[/url] house, and possibly has had a connection with [url=/c24581]Ichigo[/url] for a longer time.
